schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to come home at night without travelling alone on public transport?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في العودة إلى البيت ليلًا دون السفر وحدك في النقل العام؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, nachts nach Hause zu kommen, ohne allein mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu fahren?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to come home at night without travelling alone on public transport?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که شب بدون سفر تنها با حمل‌ونقل عمومی به خانه برگردید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de rentrer la nuit sans devoir voyager seul·e dans les transports en commun ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy éjszaka úgy hazajutni, hogy ne kelljen egyedül utaznia tömegközlekedéssel?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a tornare a casa di notte senza viaggiare da sola o da solo sui mezzi pubblici?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, geceleri toplu taşımayla yalnız yolculuk etmeden eve dönmekten vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
